key_impacts: Over 1.3 million people evacuated in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.
Subsequent floods caused 24 additional deaths (23 in Odisha, 1 in Andhra Pradesh).
18 districts in Odisha and 3 districts in Andhra Pradesh affected; flooding also reported in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
National highways and other major roads were closed; helicopters and alternate transport used for rescues.
evidence_snippets: On 12 Oct 2013, Phailin crossed the coast south of Brahmapur, Odisha.
18 districts in Odisha and 3 in Andhra Pradesh were affected; significant flooding in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
There were 21 deaths due to the cyclone; subsequent floods claimed 23 more in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh.
